caption: Figure 1: Parameter counts of several recently released pretrained language models.
description:
This figure is a line graph showing the number of parameters in millions for various language models over time. The x-axis represents the timeline from April 2018 to July 2019, while the y-axis represents the number of parameters in millions. The graph includes data points for models such as ELMo, BERT-Large, GPT, MT-DNN, XLM, RoBERTa, DistilBERT, and Megatron-LM. The highest number of parameters is observed for Megatron-LM with 8300 million, and the lowest is for ELMo with 94 million.

Text in figure: Megatron-LM 8300, ELMo 94, BERT-Large 340, GPT 110, MT-DNN 330, XLM 665, RoBERTa 355, DistilBERT 66, OpenAi, A12, GPT-2 1500, Grover Mega 1500, Google A, Transformer ELMo 465, University of Washington, Carnegie Mellon University, April 2018, July 2018, October 2018, January 2019, April 2019, July 2019.
